study_identification_part.si_4_title: Social behavior in ASD males: The interplay between cognitive flexibility, working memory, and functional connectivity deviations

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Data were from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and ABIDE II collections. Specific sites included Georgetown University, University of Utah, UCLA, UC Davis, Yale, San Diego State, Erasmus MC, University of Miami, Stanford, University of Michigan, Trinity Centre, Kennedy Krieger Institute, NYU Langone, University of Pittsburgh, Olin Institute, University of Leuven, and LMU Munich.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Data for the current study were from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and ABIDE II collections... Supplementary Table 1 summarizes the site-specific inclusion and exclusion criteria."

answer.ABIDE (I+II): normative training (80% non-ASD), normative testing (20% non-ASD), and clinical analysis (ASD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: 80% of non-ASD males (n=321) were used for training the normative models. The remaining 20% of non-ASD males (n=77) and all ASD males (n=418) were used as the testing dataset to calculate deviation scores and analyze associations with behavior.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The study dataset was then split into training and testing datasets. The training dataset was composed of 80 % of non-ASD males, while the testing dataset was composed of the remaining 20 % of non-ASD males and ASD males."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Chan2025A.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Cohort, Paragraph 1

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Training dataset: n = 321 non-ASD males. Testing dataset (control): n = 77 non-ASD males. Total HC = 398.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "The training dataset was composed of 80 % of non-ASD males (n = 321), while the testing dataset was composed of the remaining 20 % of non-ASD males... Testing (Control) N = 77"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Training (N=321): Mean 10.6, SD 1.8, Range 5.9-13.9. Testing Control (N=77): Mean 10.8, SD 1.6, Range 6.5-13.8. Weighted Mean = (321*10.6 + 77*10.8)/398 = 10.64. Pooled SD calculated.
